title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: Twisted's DeferredLock exposes a `locked()` method, not a `locked` attribute. Accessing `self._export_lock.locked` raises an AttributeError, causing the extension to crash when starting a new batch.

title: Unawaited lock acquisition
detail: Calling `self._export_lock.acquire()` returns a Deferred that is never awaited or chained, which can lead to the lock never being released if the Deferred fails or is never fired. This may cause deadlocks or missed items.
